name: gengora
description: Real-time code generation with hot-reload support. Watch your generator project and see generated code update instantly.

gengora.serverPath.description: Optional explicit path to the compiled LSP server DLL (dotnet). Leave empty for auto-discovery.

gengora.generatorProjectPath.description: Optional: Full path to a specific .csproj file or folder containing the generator project. If not set, auto-discovers project with <IsGeneratorProject>true</IsGeneratorProject> marker. Can be absolute or relative to workspace root.

gengora.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns for files/folders to exclude from file watching. Paths are relative to the discovered generator project folder.

gengora.ignorePatterns.description: [DEPRECATED] Use gengora.excludePatterns instead. Glob patterns for files/folders to ignore within the generator folder (relative paths).

gengora.autoRunOnCompileSuccess.description: Automatically start the generator after successful compilation.

gengora.mergeGitignore.description: Automatically merge .gitignore patterns from the generator project folder with exclude patterns for file watching. Useful to avoid watching ignored files.

gengora.logLevel.description: Logging verbosity level for the Gengora output channel. Use 'info' or 'debug' for detailed output.

gengora.fileWatchIgnorePatterns.description: Additional file patterns to ignore when watching for changes (e.g., '/dist/', '*.tmp'). Standard patterns like '/bin/', '/obj/' are always ignored.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run esbuild-base -- --minify && npm run bundle-server
